verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a report that scores or evaluates how ready a repository is for autonomous agents. Repository indexing, AGENTS.md, Knowledge onboarding and environment configuration are related onboarding features, not a readiness assessment, so they earn no credit. The axis is a fair question for an autonomous coding agent, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run a readiness report that evaluates how ready my repository is for autonomous agents
